name: polish
description: Performs a final quality pass fixing alignment, spacing, consistency, and micro-details.

name: critique
description: Evaluates design from a UX perspective, assessing visual hierarchy, emotional resonance, cognitive load.

name: audit
description: Runs technical quality checks across accessibility (WCAG), performance, theming, responsive design.

name: animate
description: Enhances features with purposeful animations, micro-interactions, and motion design.

name: layout
description: Improves layout, spacing, visual rhythm, and hierarchy.

name: typeset
description: Improves typography: font choices, hierarchy, sizing, weight, and readability.

name: normalize
description: Extracts and standardizes design tokens across colors, spacing scales, and radiuses.

name: clarify
description: Improves unclear UX copy, error messages, microcopy, labels, and instructions.

name: delight
description: Adds moments of joy, personality, and unexpected touches that elevate functional UI.

name: harden
description: Makes interfaces production-ready with error handling, i18n, and overflow management.

name: onboard
description: Designs onboarding flows, first-run experiences, and contextual empty states.

name: distill
description: Strips designs to their essence by removing unnecessary complexity and visual noise.

name: colorize
description: Adds strategic color to features that are too monochromatic or lack visual interest.

name: bolder
description: Amplifies safe or boring designs to make them more visually interesting and impactful.

name: quieter
description: Tones down visually aggressive or overstimulating designs, restoring calm aesthetics.

name: overdrive
description: Pushes interfaces past conventional limits with shaders, spring physics, and 60fps canvas.

name: shape
description: Plans UX and UI before code through multi-round discovery interviews and design briefs.

name: live
description: Interactive live variant mode hot-swapping HTML+CSS via HMR dev server.

name: document
description: Generates a tool-compatible DESIGN.md capturing visual system and atmosphere.

name: extract
description: Pulls reusable patterns, components, and design tokens into the design system.

name: adapt
description: Adapts designs across different screen sizes, devices, breakpoints, and touch ergonomics.

name: explore
description: Searches and discovers 21st.dev and community component registries.

name: sync
description: Synchronizes local tokens and components with external registries.

name: loop
description: Gauntlet loop continuous visual verification and browser testing iteration.
